text: This report provides information on the status of the Exhibition Place health and safety system, specifically on activities, priorities, and performance during the third quarter of 2021. There were 0 lost time injuries and the number of medical aid injuries in the third quarter were 0 for 2021 which was the same as in 2020. Workplace Safety and Insurance Board (WSIB) invoiced costs for third quarter 2021 were 61 percent lower than in third quarter 2020. A decrease in Long Term Disability costs and repayment of a WSIB claim appeal win are attributable to the lower WSIB fees.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (November 18, 2021) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
